description:
Configure a product review system for the Urban Electronics store. You need to:

1. Create a new Comment Type with the label 'Product Review' and machine name 'product_review'.
2. Add a comment field to the 'Default' Product type. Label it 'Reviews' and use the machine name 'field_reviews'. Ensure it uses the 'Product Review' comment type you just created.
3. Verify your configuration by navigating to the 'Sony WH-1000XM5 Wireless Headphones' product page and posting a review with the subject 'Amazing Quality' and body 'Best headphones I've ever owned.'.

Start by navigating to Structure > Comment types.
